paragraphs: I’m Kryštof. I’ve always been somewhere between visual work and figuring out how things are built. I studied software engineering, which probably explains why I tend to drift into the technical side of projects instead of stopping at the design.
Most of my work happens alongside small design studios and independent creatives. Good ideas, small teams, and not too many layers between thinking of something and actually making it.
Outside of work, I’m usually travelling with my wife, getting into all things aviation ✈️, or sharing a beer with friends 🍺.
